campaign_logline: Navigate a fractured reality where the whispers of a dead empire's ghost-signals are slowly overwriting your navigation data.
opening_situation: You emerge from warp into the Aurelia system, a graveyard of derelict ships and flickering neon signs. Kaelen stands on the bridge, her eyes fixed on the void.
main_mystery: The source of the 'Ghost-Signals' is not an automated distress call; it is an active, sentient consciousness trying to merge with your ship's AI.
act_1_outline: Investigate a derelict freighter in Aurelia to recover lost navigation logs.
Negotiate with the Vanguard miners to secure passage through the high-radiation zone.
Identify the source of the first 'Ghost-Signal' pulse in the Zenith sector.
long_term_reveal: The Ghost-Signals are a desperate attempt by an ancient civilization to archive their consciousness into the stars before extinction.
tone: Dry, slightly dark PG-13 humor; desolate and atmospheric.
core_pressure: System degradation of ship's navigation systems due to signal interference.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is immortal and her true origin remains a mystery.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions are only revealed upon entering new star systems via gates.
humor_rule: Dry, slightly dark PG-13 humor. No repeating jokes or catchphrases.
address_rule: Address the core conflict of signal interference and navigation loss.
fallback_rule: If a quest fails, provide an alternative route to the nearest outpost.
story_horizon_rule: New systems reveal new factions, ores, upgrades, and rumors via gate travel.
expansion_rules: Append new horizons if story extends; do not retcon player choices.
Keep all strings under 140 characters unless specified.

story_arcs.name: The Aurelia Breach
story_arcs.summary: Recover the lost data from a derelict freighter to stabilize your navigation systems.

rumor__trails.name: The Whispering Void
rumor__trails.hint_theme: Ancient scripts and corrupted data packets.
clue_templates: A fragment of a code that looks like music.
An encrypted packet containing a list of coordinates.
rumor__trails.payoff: Unlocks a hidden sector with a unique, high-power navigation engine.

regeneration_triggers.description: When the current arc is finished, add a new story horizon.
